description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the s_pop frequency (x-axis) and the accuracy (y-axis) of Llama3.3 on PopQA. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" and ranges from 1 to 19, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot features two lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers and a green solid line with square markers. The blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.8 at s_pop frequency 1, peaks at 1.0 around s_pop frequency 3, and then gradually declines to 0.8 at s_pop frequency 19. The green line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.4 at s_pop frequency 1, fluctuates between approximately 0.4 and 0.6 across the s_pop frequencies, and then sharply increases to 1.0 at s_pop frequency 19.
